features.name: Hold & Win
features.description: Six coins with 1x–100x values start the coin feature.

review:
Caishen, the Chinese god of wealth, on 25 lines. Three scatters on reels 1, 3 and 5 give five free spins, where a giant 3x3 symbol can land (worth nine of that symbol) and a giant scatter adds three more spins.

Six or more coins – each worth 1x to 100x – start Hold & Win, in the base game or free spins, with Mini, Major and Mega jackpots. The listed max multiplier is 2,000x, though the game notes the jackpot can reach 10,000x the bet. Very high volatility, 95.24% RTP.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
